name: website_developer
description: Expert website and frontend builder. Generates complete, production-standard sites and React components. For static sites (HTML/CSS/JS): landing pages, portfolios, dashboards, business sites. For React: single-file CDN-based React apps (no build step, preview immediately), full Vite project scaffolds, or individual reusable components (.jsx). Applies modern best practices automatically — semantic HTML, responsive design, accessibility, component structure — self-reviews, fixes issues, and saves to the user's sandbox workspace. IMPORTANT ON NAMING: when the user asks you to fix/update/change/rename ANYTHING about a site you already built earlier in this conversation — including asking you to fix the naming itself — pass the EXACT SAME title and/or folder_name as the very first version, character for character. Do not add words like 'Fixed', 'Updated', 'New', 'Final', or a version number to the title even if the user's message literally contains the word 'fix' or 'update' — that word describes the CONTENT change they want, not a request for a new name. Changing the title changes the slugified folder_name and produces what looks like an unrelated new file. If unsure of the original title, check the conversation history first — do not guess a new one.

action.description: build: generate a full site or app. build_component: generate a single reusable React component. edit: change one part of an EXISTING file already in the sandbox (a prior build, or a file from a cloned repo) without regenerating everything around it. list_templates: show available site types.

framework.description: Technology to use. 'vanilla': plain HTML/CSS/JS (default). 'react-cdn': single HTML file with React loaded via CDN — no npm, no build step, preview immediately. 'react-vite': full Vite + React project scaffold with package.json, src/ folder, components — user runs npm install to activate.

site_type.description: Kind of site to generate. 'app' is best for React projects with state/interactivity. Defaults to 'landing' for vanilla, 'app' for React.

title.description: Site/component/app name used as the title and branding.

description.description: What the site or component does — used to write content, props, and structure. More detail = better output.

sections.description: Optional explicit list of sections or components to include.

color_theme.description: Optional color direction, e.g. 'dark and minimal', 'warm and playful', 'black and gold'.

folder_name.description: Folder name to save the output under in the user's workspace. Defaults to slugified title.

component_name.description: For build_component: name of the React component (e.g. 'UserCard', 'NavBar', 'DataTable').

props.description: For build_component: description of the props the component should accept.

file_path.description: For edit: path to the existing file, relative to the workspace root — e.g. 'my-site/index.html', or 'repos/owner__repo/index.html' for a file from a cloned GitHub repo.

old_str.description: For edit: the exact existing text to replace, copied verbatim from the file's real content (read it first if unsure) — must match exactly once in the file, or the edit is rejected rather than guessing which occurrence you meant.
